name: How much does a primary suite addition typically cost in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does a primary suite addition typically cost in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a primary suite addition in Orange County can vary significantly based on size, chosen materials, finishes, and complexity. Factors like bathroom fixtures, custom cabinetry, flooring, and exterior matching play a role. Generally, homeowners can expect a wide range, with more intricate designs and high-end finishes pushing costs higher. It's best to consult with a contractor for a detailed estimate based on your specific project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on size, materials, and complexity. Consult a contractor for an accurate estimate specific to your project in Orange County.
